questions.question_text:
End-of-block vote — you have just finished block {{ cycle }} of the experiment. Your treatment is: {{ condition }} (tokens_available = blue can give a ticket to red as a side payment; no_tokens_control = no tickets exist).

{{ history_summary }}

Now you must vote on the matching structure for the NEXT block. If 'fixed' wins by majority, you will be paired with a single partner for all periods of the next block. If 'random' wins, you will be re-matched each period from a group of {{ large_group_size }} participants.

Recall the payoff structure (red, blue):
  - Fixed pair: Y → (6, 3); Z → (0, 15)
  - Random pair: Y → (6, 3); Z → (0, 18)

Which matching structure do you prefer? Your vote will not be revealed to others.
question_options: Random partner from a larger group
